intro: The attorneys of SGSB are leaders among many prestigious legal organizations in the California family law community.

Our attorneys are highly sought-after lecturers and teachers for legal education seminars on family law issues. SGSB’s lawyers are frequently recognized for the donation of their talents, wisdom and time to the advancement of the family law practice.

entries.label: May 2024
items: Eric Sather graduated from the National Family Law Trial Advocacy Institute (NFLTI) in Houston, Texas. NFLTI is the preeminent litigation skills course dedicated exclusively to family law. During this intensive eight-day program, attendees develop skills training in all aspects of family law litigation, from opening statement to closing argument. Attendees receive hands-on training and experience in developing the theme of the case, opening statements, evidence, custody evaluations and psychological testing, business valuations, technology in the courtroom, direct and cross examination of parties and experts, and closing arguments.
